paper.title: Locally Optimal Fixed-Budget Best Arm Identification in Two-Armed Gaussian Bandits with Unknown Variances

settings.name_in_paper: Fixed-budget best arm identification in two-armed Gaussian bandits with unknown variances
unmapped: The learner knows constants C_mu, C_sigma2 with mu_a in [-C_mu, C_mu] and sigma_a^2 in [C_sigma2, 1/C_sigma2]
Arm-dependent variances (fixed per arm, unknown to learner)
Small-gap regime: results stated as Delta -> 0 after T -> infinity
settings.definition_quote: There are two arms $1$ and $2$, and an arm $a \in \{1, 2\}$ has an $\mathbb{R}$-valued Gaussian reward $Y_a \sim \mathcal{N}(\mu_a, \sigma_a^2)$ with the mean $\mu_a \in [-C_{\mu}, C_{\mu}]$ and the variance $\sigma_a^2 \in [C_{\sigma^2}, 1/C_{\sigma^2}]$ for some universal constants $C_{\mu}, C_{\sigma^2} > 0$. We assume that $C_{\mu}$ and $C_{\sigma^2}$ are \emph{known} to us

algorithms.name: NA-AIPW strategy (Neyman Allocation + Augmented Inverse Probability Weighting)

bound.regime: small-gap regime: as Delta -> 0, up to an additive -o(Delta^2) term; bound is on the exponent liminf -(1/T) log P(error)

conditions: mu_a in [-C_mu, C_mu] and sigma_a^2 in [C_sigma2, 1/C_sigma2] with known constants independent of T

source.label: thm:optimal
source.quote: For any $P^*\in\mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{G}}$ with known constants $C_{\mu}, C_{\sigma^2} > 0$ independent of $T$, if $\{(Y_{1,t}, Y_{2,t})\}_{t\in[T]}$ is generated from $P^*$, the following holds as $\Delta \to 0$: \liminf_{T \to \infty} - \frac{1}{T}\log \mathbb{P}_{P^*}\left(\widehat{a}^{\mathrm{AIPW}}_T \neq a^\star(P^*)\right) \geq \frac{\Delta^2}{2(\sigma_1 + \sigma_2)^2} - o\left(\Delta^2\right).

results.notes: Lower bound on the error exponent, i.e. an upper bound on misidentification probability. Expression is the exponent rate; the -o(Delta^2) correction is omitted from the expression and described in regime. Matches Kaufmann et al. lower bound as Delta->0.

bound.regime: small-gap regime: as Delta -> 0, up to an additive -o(Delta^2) term; bound on exponent liminf -(1/T) log P(error)

source.label: thm:suboptimal
source.quote: For any $P^*\in\mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{G}}$, the following holds as $\Delta \to 0$: \liminf_{T \to \infty} - \frac{1}{T}\log \mathbb{P}_{P^*}\left(\widehat{a}^{\mathrm{IPW}}_T \neq a^\star(P^*)\right) \geq \frac{\Delta^2}{2(\sigma_1 + \sigma_2)\left(\frac{\zeta^*_1}{\sigma_1} + \frac{\zeta^*_2}{\sigma_2}\right)}- o\left(\Delta^2\right), where $\zeta^*_a \coloneqq \mathbb{E}_{P^*}\big[Y^2_{a, t}\big]$.

results.notes: Suboptimal exponent for the IPW variant; proof is a sketch reusing Theorem 4.1's argument.
